resources.string: Starts the A/C at a level that fits the car\'s temperature.
Sign in with your BYD account and pick your car. Password and PIN stay encrypted on this phone.
Your password and PIN stay encrypted on this phone and are only sent to BYD.
BYD server (set automatically from the country)
Starts the car when your phone gets within the start distance. It can start again only after you get further than the re-arm distance and the minimum minutes have passed.
Phone location can be off by several metres. Anyone holding your phone can trigger it.

While GPS monitoring is on, joining one of these networks arms the distance trigger, as if you had walked away. Nothing is sent to the car, and the car is never started while you are on one of these networks. Connect to the network, then tap Add current Wi-Fi.
Start car reads the cabin temperature (outside, if the car has no cabin reading) and starts the A/C at the matching level.
Combine steps into one button. Custom actions can go on the widget or run on auto-start.
Only needed once you have a Bluetooth transmitter in the car. A car\'s normal Bluetooth connection usually can\'t be found by this scan.
BYD Arrival can start your car as you walk up to it, using your phone\'s location and the car\'s parked position.
When you come within the start distance, the app runs your auto-start action. By default that\'s Start car.
Once you\'re past the re-arm distance, it\'s ready for your next return. It can\'t fire again until then.
The car never starts while your phone is on a Wi-Fi network you list in Settings.
Start with these values and adjust them after trying it. You can change them later in Settings.
Phone location can be several metres off, so very short distances may not work reliably.
Must be further than the start distance. The app raises it if needed.
Stops it starting again if you walk past the car soon after.
Starts within %1$d m, re-arms beyond %2$d m, and starts at most once every %3$d min.
Your car will start for real when you walk up to it. It has to see you walk away first, so turning it on beside the car does nothing. To turn it off, tap Stop in its notification.
Android will ask for location access. Choose Allow all the time so it works with the screen off.
Auto-start needs location access. You can start it later in Settings.
Tap a button to control your car
One-tap start, lock, unlock and trunk
